messages.subject: a question about rjmcmc
parts:
Hi team,

I have the following for the indicator variable (z) and the corresponding slope (zbeta), which seems to be the standard way of using rjmcmc in Nimble: 

[408567] RJ_indicator sampler: z_lambda0_br[1],  mean: 0,  scale: 0.20000000000000001,  targetNode: zbeta_lambda0_br[1]

[408588] RJ_toggled sampler: zbeta_lambda0_br[11],  samplerType: RW

My question is, is there a way to change the sampler of the slopes to something like RW_block_sampler (while maintaining rjmcmc)? Are there any benefits to do so? Please let me know. Thank you.

Best,
Qing

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: a question about rjmcmc
parts:
Off the top of my head, I don't think so, because that would only make sense for a block of nodes toggled jointly, and it's not set up that way.

One could copy the source code for the samplers and start modifying for different or more general cases.

Perry
